completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1965/ra_4293_1965.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
The areas covering Paliparan Subdivision, Better Homes, Inc., and abandoned Manila Railroad tracks, within the Municipality of Marikina, Province of Rizal, are hereby constituted into a barrio in said municipality, to be known as Barrio of Malaya.
The boundaries of said barrio shall be as follows:
On the North, the 14-meter wide road and an imaginary line going West to East; on the East, the first creek near Barrio Parang; on the South, the Marikina townsite, including the hospital site and property of Roberto Tuason; and on the West, the Sto. Niño (Lazaro Estate, Manotok Subdivision), Lamuan (Malanday, Manotok, Inc.) Concepcion (Manotok Subdivision), and property of Gregorio San Diego, and others.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
